restoration_note: The teaching describes the chain of inward-gathering (ⲥⲱⲩϩ ⲁϩⲟⲩⲛ) by which each degree of the rational/natural is drawn up into the one above it: light → fire → water → wind → [winds/all] → Tamr → Answer (ⲡⲟⲩⲱϣⲃⲉ) → Call (ⲡⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ) → chosen Mind/Noeric → Pillar of Glory → First Man → Ambassador → Aeons of the Greatness, all rising together into the upper place of rest. Most gaps are tightly constrained: single-letter completions of standard technical terms (ⲥⲧⲟⲓⲭⲉⲓⲟⲛ, ⲡⲥⲧⲩⲗⲟⲥ ⲙ̄ⲡⲉⲁⲩ, ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ, ⲁⲛⲁⲓⲱⲛ, ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲡⲉ), iterative formula-fills for the elements (water clause), and grammatical particles (ⲁ-, ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ, ⲉⲩ-). The only weakly constrained gap is {5}: editor reads [ⲧⲏ]ⲩ but the position in the chain (between water/wind and Tamr) and plural verb ⲥⲱⲩϩ suggest this is the plural 'winds' or 'spirits' (ⲡⲛⲁ̄ⲩ), one register above wind in the cosmic ladder. I retain the editor's ⲧⲏ.

Completes ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'the light' across the line break; light is the lowest element in the chain, gathering to fire. Lexicon: ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ.
Directional preposition ⲁ- 'to' before ⲧⲥⲉⲧⲉ; standard pattern X ⲥⲱⲩⲍ ⲁⲍⲟⲩⲛ ⲁ-Y.

coptic_restorations.basis: Editor's iterative formula-fill: 'fire gathers in[ward to the water of the water; the water itself] gathers inward to the wind of the [wind].' Reproduces the parallel structure of the surrounding lines (light→fire, fire→water, water→wind).

Editor reads [ⲧⲏ]ⲩ; in the cosmic ladder this register (after wind, before Tamr) is the plural 'winds/spirits' or 'all,' subject of plural verb ⲥⲱⲩϩ. Position in the chain weakly constrains the exact term; the editor's letters are retained.
Genitive linker ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ joining the previous segment ('Tamr') to ⲡⲟⲩⲱϣⲃⲉ; standard formula X ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ X.
Directional ⲁ- + masculine article ⲡ- before ⲛⲟⲩⲥ ⲉⲧⲥⲁⲧϥ̄ 'the chosen Mind'; standard 'gathered to the X.'
Definite article ⲡ- + ⲥ initial of ⲡⲥⲧⲩⲗⲟⲥ ⲙ̄ⲡⲉⲁⲩ 'the Pillar of Glory'; lexicon ⲡⲥⲧⲩⲗⲟⲥ ⲙ̄ⲡⲉⲁⲩ.
Repetition: 'the Pillar of Glory [gathers] to the First [Man]'; same restoration as {8}.
Completes ⲡⲣⲱⲙⲉ in ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'the First Man' across the line break; standard Manichaean cosmogonic figure.
Initial alpha of ⲁⲛⲁⲓⲱⲛ 'Aeons' (preceded by directional ⲁ- assimilated); ⲁⲛⲁⲓⲱⲛ ⲛ̄ⲧⲙ̄ⲛ̄ⲧⲛⲁⲟ̄ = the Aeons of the Greatness, the highest term of the chain.
Future III converter ⲉⲩⲛⲁⲥⲱⲩϩ 'they shall gather'; matches the parallel future ⲛ̄ⲥⲉⲃⲱⲕ ⲁϩⲣⲏⲓ̈ 'they shall go up' that follows.
Initial ⲥ- of ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲡⲉ 'the upper place' (lexicon ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲡⲉ/ⲡⲭⲓⲥⲉ); standard cosmological designation paired with ⲡⲙⲁⲛⲙ̄ⲧⲁⲛ 'place of rest.'
